text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What a stroke of luck! Perfect timing!
Do you all have some time right now?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "I was just on my way to test the VR Umalator's new features... and I was hoping for some real, candid feedback from students and Trainers!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A playtest. In other words, getting to play it before anyone else.
Trainer, I want to go.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What will be implemented in this update
is none other than "Animal Therapy Mode"!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"You can interact with animals in VR?
That's amazing. I'd love to try it."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Correct! Then let's give it a test run right away!
Booting up! Now, what kind of animal would you like to interact with?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That would obviously be... with each and every kitty around the whole wide world—!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, you two.
Now then, shall we call over all sorts of kitties right away?

text_block_list.name: Serval
text_block_list.text: Meoowwrl!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, don't worry, it's just VR.
Even if you get bitten, you won't get hurt at all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A serval cat, so close up!
I heard they're the fastest in the feline family after cheetahs!
Cute! Fast! Absolutely marvelous!
choice_data_list: It's great being able to play with animals like that!
It's great being able to play with animals like that!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There, there, there, who's a good boy! Tickle tickle tickle!
So cute, so cute, so cute!
choice_data_list: I wasn't listening... but it sounds like you had fun, and that's what matters!
I wasn't listening... but it sounds like you're having fun, and that's what matters!

text_block_list.name: Pallas's Cat
text_block_list.text: Ah~woo, ah~woo, ah~~ooh.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So fluffy! So cute!
Pallas's cats are too ferocious to touch in real life!
But in this world, I can!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah! It bit me! But it doesn't hurt!
It's VR so it doesn't hurt! There, there, there, there!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufu, what a truly fascinating child.
...Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Tabby Cat
text_block_list.text: Meooww~

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"This is my beloved pet cat.
Isn't she just adorable?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It's super cute!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew.
We really got to enjoy all sorts of kitties today."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, that made me realize it even more painfully.
I really love ordinary kitties the best.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: So, would you mind letting me hold that tabby cat?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, thank you for the kind words.
As for me, I would love nothing more
than to let you hold me, but...

text_block_list.name: Tabby Cat
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
this little one only takes to me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I had a hard time once before when
a cat didn't warm up to me. Maybe it's best to give up this time..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We won't know until we try.
I want to become friends with the tiger-kitty.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
My, you really do love cats, don't you?
Though it's a thorny path, you know?
Whether this little one will warm up to you or not...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I don't mind. Even so, I—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There, there, who's a good boy...♡
Come here, come here...!
Here kitty, kitty, kitty...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O faced the cat with utter sincerity.
Her straightforward gaze, trying to convey love, touches the heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She gave it her all for as long as time allowed.
And finally...!
choice_data_list: Ah! The cat... it got it...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Haaahn...!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: I was shocked...! To think she would let anyone other than me hold her...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so cute.
It was insanely cute for some reason.
What in the world was that cat...?!
choice_data_list: Your love got through to them!
Our love got through to them, didn't it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so cute.
It was insanely cute for some reason.
What in the world was that cat...?!
choice_data_list: Your love got through to them!
Our love got through to them, didn't it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It is the victory of my straightforward love.
Truly, it calls for a "Yay!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"That was a great learning experience.
Next time, I'll do my best so I can hold
a real kitty too."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I'm sure you can do it.
I'll be rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If it weren't, this little one
would never entrust itself to you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I feel strange as well. That kitty is somehow exceptionally cute.
